newsitem.title: LEBANON: Beirut market starts week in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Beirut market starts week in quiet trade.

text.p: Solidere A was the only climber on the Beirut Stock Exchange in quiet trade on Monday.
BSE turnover fell 94 percent to 93,318 from 181,154 for a value of $1,253,155 against $2,092,210.
The LIBX bank index fell 0.40 percent to 189.27 and the LISPI rose 0.07 percent to 96.33 while the BLOM rose 0.94 percent to 1101.6.
Solidere A rose to $12.875 from $12.625. Solidere B shares were unchanged at $12.875. The company's global depositary receipts traded at $17.325 on the London Stock Exchange on Monday.
Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce fell to $20.5 from $20.75.
Banque Audi was steady at $27.25. Bank of Beirut was unchanged at $5.50.
Ciments Libanais, the only industrial share traded, was steady at $1.2813.
There was no trade in the other listed industrial firms -- Eternit, Uniceramic and Ciments Blancs.
